case_number: Civil Appeal No. 3897 of 2023; Civil Appeal No. 3898 of 2023; Civil Appeal No. 3899 of 2023

parties.respondent: The Brihan Mumbai Electric Supply & Transport Undertaking (BEST) and Others

summary: Tender dispute over electric bus specifications; technical deviation in bid compliance; 'actual conditions' vs 'standard test conditions' for minimum range requirement; Annexure Y submission and revision by Evey Trans; rejection of Tata Motors on grounds of non-compliance; high court upheld disqualification; pre-bid request not accepted by tendering authority; no consideration of deviation as 'clerical error' permitted; bid evaluation process adhered to; eligibility criteria strictly applied for opening price bids; final decision sustaining technical rejection of Tata Motors' bid.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment upheld; disqualification of Tata Motors sustained; tender award to Evey Trans upheld.
